AgentSessionServices [agent-session-services.ts; held by runtime]
|
|-- cwd / agentDir / diagnostics [creation context and non-fatal issues]
|-- SettingsManager [created or supplied; also referenced by session + loader]
|   |-- SettingsStorage [file backend by default; custom/in-memory supported]
|   |-- globalSettings + projectSettings -> merged settings
|   |-- projectTrusted + load errors + diagnostic errors
|   `-- Modified-field sets/maps + writeQueue -> scoped persistence
|-- ResourceLoader [retained reference; default implementation below]
|   `-- DefaultResourceLoader [resource-loader.ts]
|       |-- SettingsManager reference -> same bundle settings, not a new owner
|       |-- EventBus [supplied or created] + DefaultPackageManager [created]
|       |-- Configured paths / inline factories / overrides / disable flags
|       |-- extensionsResult [loaded extensions, errors, ExtensionRuntime]
|       |   `-- getExtensions() -> session constructs/binds ExtensionRunner
|       |-- Cached resources: skills / prompts / themes / context files
|       |-- System/append prompts + source paths + resource metadata
|       `-- reload() -> refresh resource caches and diagnostics
|-- ModelRuntime [created or supplied; internals in boundary diagram]
|   `-- <- session routing + SDK-installed Agent streaming callbacks
`-- Factory relationships [external functions, not retained parts]
    |-- <- createAgentSessionServices(): construct/load bundle
    |   `-- Register providers/models; refresh locally; collect flag diagnostics
    `-- -> createAgentSessionFromServices(): pass shared references to SDK
        `-- -> AgentSession and Agent callbacks share these services
